claims.claim: SELF-RAG decides whether to invoke the retriever by generating a special retrieval token.
When SELF-RAG outputs the retrieval token, it calls the retriever on demand.
Standard RAG does not make an explicit decision on when to retrieve.
Standard RAG always applies its retriever to the input sequence.
